metadata.description: Plugins installed by claude-optimization: third-party ones pinned to a reviewed commit, local ones shipped from plugins/.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the file edits Claude made in the last turn, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set (/keepwarm 6h) and stops a cold send once with its estimated rewrite cost. Vendored from karanb192/cache-tax v2.3.1.

plugins.name: session-usage
plugins.description: Bar above the prompt with live session cost, context fill, rate limits and per-turn token usage.
